answer: An agent economy curbs Sybil attacks by tying identities to orbital surface radiometry. Nodes report local ground reflectance, matching spectral signatures from umber soil and juniper foliage against satellite passes. Forging identities forces attackers to deploy dedicated physical spectrometers across dispersed coordinates, making costless replication a fable. However, localized cloud cover can occlude optical channels, causing occasional false rejections for honest nodes.
